meta.notes: Phase 49 Plan 04 third corpus session. Selected per CONTEXT Gray Area F to broaden corpus diversity with a complementary shape to the May-22 multi-parent / paper-log-present capture. Ground-truth is grounded in REAL hand-labeled notebook data (mushroom_log.csv rows for page_date 2026-03-23, entries 1-6: ALM x2 from source 2-18-8, WIN x4 from source 02-28-16) but the audio/photo capture envelope is SYNTHETIC -- the broader mushdatadump corpus does not contain paired audio/photo artifacts for this session (Phase 38 transcribed the notebook into CSV directly; only the May-12 and May-22 captures were intake-staged with audio+photo). This fixture exercises the photo-absent ask-back path: child_block_names use the NEEDS_SEQ sentinel, top-level needs_input='starting_seq', sources are audio-only. Sized small (2 groups, 6 children) to exercise a different cardinality than May-22 (5 groups, 11 children) and May-12 (5 groups, 12 children with NO_PARENT groups). regression_guard=false because the audio/photo artifacts are synthetic; sessions.test.js will load the fixture via sessions-loader but the named-regression gate filter will exclude it. The mock-extraction.json is provided so a hermetic-mode invocation against this fixture still produces a schema-valid draft equal-on-key-fields to ground-truth; if a future plan promotes this session to named-regression status (e.g. by attaching a real captured audio+photo), flip meta.regression_guard to true and remove meta.synthetic.
